messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired (PD #9457) — GPU OOM spike on cluster-inference-prod-3. Trigger: cuda:alloc failed across multiple pods, 50% of model-serving pods restarting. Severity: high. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-9457

sam_oncall: acked. I'm on it — checking logs and nvidia-smi now.

maria_sre: on call, joining. any obvious customer hits?

sam_oncall: seeing repeated 'CUDA out of memory' in /var/log/pods/model-serving/*.log. KV cache growth looks unbounded for a few recent requests. batch_size spikes to 64 in traces around 17:12:02 UTC.

sam_oncall: quick ps + nvidia-smi snapshot:
```
# nvidia-smi -L
GPU 0: NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB (UUID: GPU-abc)
GPU 1: NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB (UUID: GPU-def)

# nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY
GPU 0 Memory Usage: 39220 MiB / 40960 MiB
Processes: python(28123) 38000 MiB, python(28145) 1200 MiB
GPU 1 Memory Usage: 35012 MiB / 40960 MiB
Processes: python(28200) 34000 MiB, python(28210) 1000 MiB
```

sam_oncall: looks like fragmentation + two large model processes per GPU. autoscaler tried to spin up nodes but some pods failed scheduling due to pack affinity.

devops-bot: autoscaler event: attempted scale-up +3 nodes -> 2 nodes provisioned; 1 provisioning failed due to quota.

sam_oncall: immediate mitigation proposal (short list):
1) route traffic off infer-prod-3 -> mark as degraded in router
2) roll pods on that node with reduced batch size (env BATCH_MAX=16)
3) enable CPU fallback variant for low-priority routes
4) cordon+drain node if memory remains saturated
5) open customer-facing note if impact > 1% requests

maria_sre: agreed. I'll coordinate node cordon/drain with infra. kai_infra, can you take node operations?

kai_infra: taking node ops. which node names? getting `kubectl get nodes -l pool=inference-prod-3 -o name` now.

kai_infra: running: `kubectl cordon node/ip-10-0-45-127` -> cordoned.

kai_infra: starting drain: `kubectl drain node/ip-10-0-45-127 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`
```
I0812 17:15:02.123 drain.go:... Evicting pod model-serving-xyz from node/ip-10-0-45-127
Evicted 12 pods, 3 failed due to pod disruption budget (pdb)
```

kai_infra: drain is partial because of PDBs. I'll force-evict after talking to apps owners unless Sam wants immediate force.

sam_oncall: force-evict if memory still > 35GB after warm-up. Meanwhile I'll kick a rolling restart on model-serving with BATCH_MAX=16.

sam_oncall: rolling restart command: `kubectl -n inference set env deploy/model-serving BATCH_MAX=16 && kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-serving`

sam_oncall: also applied temporary routing config to send 20% traffic to small-variant (model-small-v2) for affected routes:
```
PUT /api/v1/routing/config
{ "route":"/api/generate","variants": [{"id":"model-default","weight":80},{"id":"model-small-v2","weight":20}]}
```

nina_se: support reporting: we've got 3 open high-priority tickets referencing timeouts/503s from partners. one customer (acct: acme-analytics) reported failures for long-run requests. they were routed to the affected cluster.

sam_oncall: estimated impact: 2-3% error rate on generate endpoints from 17:11–17:26 UTC, tail latency > 10s for some requests. working on bringing that down under 1%.

maria_sre: escalating to infra pager for quota failure that blocked scale-up. @kai_infra please include cloud-account team.

kai_infra: contacted cloud-ops, they increased quota for GPUs in us-west-2 region, new nodes provisioning now.

devops-bot: deployment event: model-serving rollout started at 1798004375.

sam_oncall: monitoring: after BATCH_MAX change and partial draining, OOM logs decreased, new pods started on fresh nodes with single model process per GPU.

sam_oncall: sample log tail showing allocation success:
```
[17:22:10] INFO model-serving: allocated KV cache 3.2GB for session 0x7f3ab...
[17:22:11] INFO model-serving: serving request id=abc123 latency=0.72s
```

kai_infra: drain completed for ip-10-0-45-127 after force-evict. node is cordoned and unschedulable.

maria_sre: follow-up action list for post-incident:
- add guardrail to limit batch_size spikes to 48 for production ephemeral workloads
- add KV cache soft-limit per-session + eviction policy
- review autoscaler failure modes for quota exhaustion and add alert for scale-up failure
- run postmortem and notify impacted customers with timeline

nina_se: I'll draft customer note summarizing impact and mitigations, pinging legal for wording for enterprise customers.

jordan_rt: I'll take 30-min watch and then formal handoff to next oncall (overnight). please ping me if regression.

sam_oncall: handing off monitoring to @jordan_rt. current status: error rate down to 0.6%, OOM logs not appearing for 10m. autoscaler finished provisioning +2 nodes.

incident-bot: Incident PD-9457 status -> monitoring. PagerDuty: acknowledged by sam_oncall, escalated to infra.

jordan_rt: ack. I'll keep eyes on pod restarts and tail GPU memory metrics for 45m. leaving notes in oncall runbook.

sam_oncall: thanks team — will write short postmortem and include exact log snippets + config diffs.

maria_sre: closing immediate page. moving to post-incident review channel for RCA. :thumbsup:
